notes: Read 2026-11-21 (HTTP 200, 07:06Z UTC). Two milestones with Antom, which Mastercard calls Ant International's merchant payment and digitalization platform: a live consumer transaction in which an AI agent bought a cup of coffee on the consumer's pre-captured intent, with acceptance supported by Antom, which Mastercard says ran on Agent Pay with Verifiable Intent; and a completed Agent Pay for Machines pilot with Antom in Singapore that built on the AP4M demonstration at Cloudflare Connect. The release describes Agent Pay as bringing together network tokenization, authentication and consumer intent, and presents Verifiable Intent as part of that framework. It quotes Joyce Bo (Mastercard) and Chunmao Zhu (Antom). It names no merchant, no market for the coffee purchase, no Verifiable Intent layer or mode and no party that checked the chain, and it gives no volume, pricing or change to AP4M availability. No Ant International copy was found.
